caption: The drawing depicts a lidded jar placed on a shallow plate, both of which are decorated with intricate designs primarily in shades of brown, yellow, and orange. The jar is ornamented with a pattern featuring a large bird with spotted wings, surrounded by stylized leaves and flowers. The plate beneath the jar has a matching floral motif visible on its interior surface. Above and to the left of the jar and plate is a stylized red flower with flanking floral motifs and curling stems, labeled “Inside of Plate” and dated “1826.” To the upper right, there is a simple, stylized red flower labeled “Reverse Side of Jar.” The main objects and motifs are outlined in fine brown and red lines, with shading and color washes giving depth. There is a small monochrome outline sketch of the jar and plate in the bottom right corner. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Pa. German Covered Jar
